direct.title: Settle
direct.explanation: Let the cable come to rest on the desk.
direct.sensing: Observe shape stability in successive images; check sensor health before approaching.
direct.risk: A sleeping or artificially damped simulated cable can conceal poor dynamics.

direct.title: Approach pick
direct.explanation: Bring the tool into the desk pickup region.
direct.sensing: Use the global camera to locate the cable and select a reachable, unobstructed patch.
direct.risk: A fixed nominal pickup location does not handle shifted or curled cables.

direct.title: Hover pick
direct.explanation: Pause above the proposed suction patch.
direct.sensing: Refine patch and face estimates from images; reject overlap and glare.
direct.risk: Do not descend when localization uncertainty exceeds the available margin.

direct.title: Descend pick
direct.explanation: Lower the suction surface onto the cable.
direct.sensing: Combine calibrated approach geometry, contact/load information and pressure onset.
direct.risk: Excess descent can press the cable into the desk or damage the tip.

direct.title: Acquire suction
direct.explanation: Establish the two compliant vacuum attachments.
direct.sensing: Require a pressure response and a visible retention check.
direct.risk: The current attachment law has no measured leakage or pneumatic delay.

direct.title: Lift
direct.explanation: Raise the cable clear of the desk.
direct.sensing: Confirm visible lift while pressure remains stable.
direct.risk: Suction pressure alone can remain plausible during a bad pickup.

direct.title: Open lower jaw
direct.explanation: Create clearance for the movable lower jaw.
direct.sensing: Read jaw position and inspect the cable path before deploying.
direct.risk: A cable loop can enter the guide clearance.

direct.title: Deploy lower jaw
direct.explanation: Move the lower jaw into the gripping region.
direct.sensing: Check encoder position, load and local view for unintended contact.
direct.risk: Deployment must not sweep through the cable or shelf.

direct.title: Pinch
direct.explanation: Close the mechanical grasp while preserving cable support.
direct.sensing: Use measured jaw load and tactile contact, then check for slip.
direct.risk: Motor position does not establish useful clamp force.

direct.title: Release after pinch
direct.explanation: Vent vacuum while keeping the mechanical preload.
direct.sensing: Verify grip from tactile/load history and visible cable retention.
direct.risk: This transition must not remove clamp preload.

direct.title: Raise after pinch
direct.explanation: Lift the retained cable into a transport pose.
direct.sensing: Check that the cable stays in the grasp as acceleration changes.
direct.risk: A static grasp can fail under motion or tubing drag.

direct.title: Transport to pcb
direct.explanation: Carry the cable into the connector work area.
direct.sensing: Use robot measurements and images to manage clearance and tip visibility.
direct.risk: Transport can alter cable shape and invalidate an earlier tip estimate.

direct.title: Align connector
direct.explanation: Orient and position the tip near the connector mouth.
direct.sensing: Fuse calibrated top/side images with tactile grasp history.
direct.risk: The historical run uses exact simulated tip pose here; the new skill must not.

direct.title: Approach slot
direct.explanation: Bring the tip to the entrance while maintaining alignment.
direct.sensing: Track image-space tip/mouth error, uncertainty and signed contact force.
direct.risk: Occlusion or an edge catch requires reobservation, not continued forward motion.

direct.title: Insert
direct.explanation: Advance the cable into the modeled slot.
direct.sensing: Use local vision, tactile history and measured wrench to detect progress or jamming.
direct.risk: The historical slot has no terminal-spring resistance, so its success is only geometric.

direct.title: Verify seating
direct.explanation: Audit full-tip geometry at the end of the historical run.
direct.sensing: Use observable seating and latch checks, followed by electrical verification after withdrawal.
direct.risk: The recorded geometric audit cannot certify a finished electrical assembly.
